description.en: Lets your agents work on your Supabase projects: browse tables, run SQL, apply migrations, read logs and manage edge functions.
description.fr: Vos agents travaillent sur vos projets Supabase : parcourir les tables, lancer du SQL, appliquer des migrations, lire les logs et gérer les edge functions.

en: Which tables of my project have no row-level security?
Write and apply a migration that adds a created_at column
Show the errors of the API logs in the last hour
fr: Quelles tables de mon projet n’ont pas de row-level security ?
